U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Housing In Congress, I am a passionate advocate for safe, affordable, and high-quality housing for all Americans. I am committed to advancing legislation that strengthens and expands federal housing assistance programs, including Section 8 vouchers, the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC), and other critical initiatives that support housing access for those who need it most. Our nation’s housing supply is far below the needs of our population, and I recognize that swift action is necessary to alleviate the burden the housing crisis places on Americans and on my constituents in the 10th District. I believe that Congress must act urgently to make rent and mortgage payments more affordable, make public housing more accessible, and ensure that homes everywhere are safer, more sustainable, and within reach for all.

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Education As a former educator, I have seen firsthand how a strong education and well-supported schools and teachers can open doors and transform lives for students. No matter their ZIP code or economic status, all students deserve the chance to thrive in school. Our state holds more than 118,000 teachers, more than 1.5 million students and one of the strongest public school systems in the nation. In our 10th District, our schools are at the heart of our communities. Yet, there is more to be done to address the challenges that our students and teachers still face. Too often, disparities in school funding and support mean that students in certain neighborhoods don’t have access to the same quality of education as others. Make no mistake, as your member of Congress, I will fight for the resources our students and teachers need to succeed. This means supporting federal funding to uplift teachers and address the issues they face head-on, expanding early childhood education programs, and investing in STEM and vocational training that prepares students for the demands of our modern economy. Education is not just a pathway to opportunity; it’s the foundation for our future in Essex, Hudson and Union counties, and beyond. Right now, our healthcare system is falling short of its responsibility to keep people healthy and provide everyone with the care they need and deserve. Breaking down the barriers that prevent access to healthcare is, to me, one of our most important responsibilities in Congress. As Representative for New Jersey’s Tenth District, I am committed to increasing investment in healthcare infrastructure for underserved communities, eliminating discrimination within our healthcare institutions, and promoting culturally competent care. I want to ensure that no vulnerable community is overlooked or left behind in our pursuit of a healthier nation. Latest May 22, 2025 McIver Statement on House Passage of GOP Tax Scam

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Environment Climate change is and will continue to affect our District and communities all across the globe. From the devastation of coastal communities, to extreme weather events, extreme heat, dangerous pollution and threats to our food system, we cannot ignore the impact of climate change and we cannot wait to act. I firmly support efforts to expand environmental protections, hold polluters accountable and create a more sustainable economy, both with legislation and through federal funding. We know all too well that the cost of inaction harms some communities more than others. Damage to our environment disproportionately impacts low-income communities and communities of color. Our strategy to address the climate crisis must confront these inequities and ensure that everyone—regardless of race, income, zip code and more—enjoys the benefits of a clean environment. That means building resilience in the most vulnerable communities, acting to right historical wrongs and giving frontline communities a voice at the table where decisions are being made. For our New Jersey communities, I am committed to securing funding for flood mitigation, enhancing environmental justice efforts, ensuring the hardest hit communities are prepared and have the resources they need, and moving legislation forward to slow the impact of climate change and set us on a course for a clean energy future.

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo LGBTQ+ Rights Our nation’s promise of justice for all must extend to every person, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other factor. As a member of Congress and a member of the Congressional Equality Caucus, I am committed to championing LGBTQ+ rights and ensuring every person can live free from discrimination and harassment. Whether at work, at school, or in healthcare institutions, we must push back against discrimination in its many forms. I am a proud co-sponsor of the Equality Act to federally enshrine protections against discrimination for LGBTQ+ people across the country. Given the mounting attacks on LGBTQ+ people nationwide, including efforts in state and local governments to strip away their basic human rights, these protections are as important as ever.

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Voting Rights I am committed to expanding and protecting the right to vote across our country. New Jerseyans know that their vote is their voice, a powerful tool in shaping the future of our communities. But New Jerseyans—especially in communities of color—are no strangers to regressive voter suppression tactics, which have historically been used to limit access to the halls of power and silence underrepresented voices. In New Jersey’s 10th District, where the legacy of the civil rights movement continues to inspire, we cannot allow voter suppression to stand in the way of progress. I will keep fighting to ensure that all my constituents—regardless of race, economic status, or neighborhood, have an equal say in our democracy. For more information on voting rights legislation, please contact my office.

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Small Business Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, creating half of our national GDP, more than half of our jobs, and creating most new employment opportunities each year. In Congress, I am dedicated to empowering entrepreneurs by fighting monopolization, fostering innovation, expanding access to capital in vulnerable communities, and streamlining regulations to help businesses thrive. Expanding access to capital for underserved communities is one way to uplift economically disadvantaged communities. By increasing support for minority-owned and women-owned businesses, we can promote diversity in entrepreneurship and ensure everyone has a fair shot at economic success. In New Jersey’s 10th Congressional District, small businesses are central to the local economy, employing over 180,000 residents across nearly 17,300 businesses. My work in Washington will focus on strengthening the foundation of these businesses, driving economic stability and wealth creation for families in Newark, East Orange, and beyond. For more information on small business issues, please contact my office. Latest January 31, 2025 McIver Appointed to Key Leadership Positions

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Reproductive Justice The right to make decisions about your body and your reproductive health is just that—yours. It should not be up to politicians to police the choices you make when it comes to the decision to start a family. I firmly oppose the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and turn back reproductive rights in this country, and I am outraged at the statewide abortion bans currently preventing millions of Americans from receiving the care they need. As a member of Congress and someone who has faced her own challenges with reproductive health, I am committed to safeguarding the rights of patients and providers as they make decisions about abortion, IVF, and contraception. I stand firmly with my colleagues in the Congressional Pro-Choice Caucus and will continue to fight against unfair restrictions that jeopardize women's health and wellbeing. We won’t back down in the fight for reproductive freedom.

U.S. House Representative LaMonica McIver Skip to content Close Home About Meet LaMonica Committees And Caucuses Our District Votes and Legislation Contact Email Me Newsletter Subscribe Office Locations Request An Appearance Media Press Releases In the News Press Kit Issues Education Environment Healthcare Housing LGBTQ+ Rights Reproductive Justice Small Business Transportation and Infrastructure Voting Rights Services Help With A Federal Agency Events Commendations And Greetings Appropriations Requests Flags Grant Applications Internships Military Academy Nominations Congressional App Challenge Poetry Contest Tours And Tickets Resources Close Congresswoman LaMonica McIver Modal Search Button MENU Facebook Logo Twitter Logo BlueSky Logo Youtube Logo Instagram Logo Transportation and Infrastructure Infrastructure investment is crucial to our nation’s economy and, for so many Americans, reliable transit systems are a lifeline. I am committed to building a safe, efficient, and sustainable transportation system that serves everyone equitably. In New Jersey’s 10th Congressional District, we are a vital regional and international transportation hub. A key stretch of the Northeast Corridor—the busiest railway in the country—runs directly through our district, and Newark Liberty International Airport, one of the busiest in the region, serves over 46 million passengers each year. Our communities rely heavily on NJ Transit and the PATH rail system, which deliver millions of commuters to neighboring cities daily. My transit advocacy as Newark City Council president led to securing $120 million from Essex County Improvement Authority to allow Newark to replace 23,000 lead service lines in under three years—a national example of how cities can tackle lead contamination quickly and effectively. I fought for $190 million for improvements and renovations of Newark Penn Station, one of the busiest transportation hubs in New Jersey, and played a vital role in upgrading our city’s water and wastewater infrastructure to transform our city for the better.
